text:
Platinum Price in 2013
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2013, the LBMA platinum price fell 18.8% between 2013-01-31 ($1,672) and 2013-12-30 ($1,357). The highest sampled price was $1,672 in January and the lowest was $1,317 in June. The mean of these observations was $1,473. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
